==Description==
'''Tutorial''' is the [[Maps|map]] used as the tutorial for the game. For the introductory stage of the game, you are forced to complete at least the first mission on [[Story Mode|Story]] mode's TDS: Boot Camp chapter, called [[Boot Camp]]. Subsequent TDS: Boot Camp missions, [[Live Fire]], [[Breach Protocol]] and [[Brute Force]] also use this map.

==Design & Path==
{{Tabber
|Current
|'''Tutorial''' is a green block with a few trees, a wooden watchtower, slightly elevated green ground and a road.

The path starts at the grey spawn point and ends at the red spawn point.
|Version 1
|'''Tutorial''' took place in a grassy plains surrounded by mountains. There were also a few cliffs on the map and a black road that acted as the enemy path. 

The path started and ended at a tunnel.
}}

==Rewards==
The '''Tutorial''' used to give out {{Coins|600}} and {{Exp|200}} upon first triumph, though due to its tutorial being incorporated into the [[Boot Camp]], this is no longer the case.

===Badges===
There is also one [[badges|badge]] which can be obtained when playing on this map. It is:

{{Badge
|title = Welcome to TDS!
|description = You completed the tutorial! Welcome to Tower Defense Simulator recruit!
|image = TutorialBadge.png
|obtainable = Yes
}}

==Strategy==
*Because of how '''Tutorial''' works, simply following the [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] can lead to triumphing this map.
**It is not possible to pick what towers are in your loadout, as they are replaced the moment the match starts. Additionally, all skins are replaced with the Default skin and golden perks are not applied.

==Trivia==
*There was an image of [https://italianbrainrot.wikioasis.org/wiki/Tung_Tung_Tung_Sahur Tung Tung Tung Sahur] on one of the trees, which ended up getting replaced by the [[Golden Snowballer]]'s icon in [[v2.7.0]].
*Despite the objective screen suggesting triumphing the '''Tutorial''' gave the [[Demoman]], this was not actually the case. The player would buy it with the {{Coins|Coins}} gotten from triumphing it instead.
